        yy= lengthdir_y(width * 1, image_angle);
        s_factor= 1;
        if(x - xx &lt; 0) {
            s_loss= abs(x - xx);
            s_factor= (width - s_loss) / width;
        }
        if(x + xx &gt; room_width) {
            s_loss= abs(x + xx - room_width);
            s_factor= (width - s_loss) / width;
        }
        xx*= s_factor;
        xx_off= lengthdir_x(1, image_angle - 90) * 18 * s_factor;
        yy_off= lengthdir_y(1, image_angle - 90) * 18;
        if(hitted == 0 &amp;&amp; collision_line(x - xx * 0.8, y - yy * 0.8, x + xx * 0.8, y + yy * 0.8, 1699, 1, 1))
            event_user(1);
        draw_set_font(2);
        draw_set_color(16777215);
        if(hitted == 1) draw_set_color(65535);
        draw_text_transformed(x - xx_off, y - yy_off, text, 2 * s_factor, 2, image_angle);
        draw_set_halign(0);
    }
    if(stretch == 2) {
        draw_set_halign(1);
        s_factor= 1;
        s_factor= stretchfactor / width;
        xx= lengthdir_x(width * 1 * s_factor, image_angle);
        yy= lengthdir_y(width * 1 * s_factor, image_angle);
        xx_off= lengthdir_x(1, image_angle - 90) * 18;
        yy_off= lengthdir_y(1, image_angle - 90) * 18;
        if(hitted == 0 &amp;&amp; collision_line(x - xx * 0.8, y - yy * 0.8, x + xx * 0.8, y + yy * 0.8, 1699, 1, 1))
            event_user(1);
        draw_set_font(2);
        draw_set_color(16777215);
        if(hitted == 1) draw_set_color(65535);
        draw_text_transformed(x - xx_off, y - yy_off, text, 2 * s_factor, 2, image_angle);
        draw_set_halign(0);
    }
}

            if(b == i || b2 == i || b3 == i &amp;&amp; bm &lt; 3) {
                bm++;
                instance_create(global.idealborder[0] + g[i] * 25, 0 - j * 45 + random(20), 445/* obj_plusbomb */);

        if(global.inv &gt;= 45) km_bonus= choose(0, 1);
        if(global.inv &gt;= 60) km_bonus= choose(0, 1, 1);
        if(global.inv &gt;= 75) km_bonus= 1;
        if(km_t &gt;= 1 + km_bonus &amp;&amp; global.km &gt;= 40) {
            km_t= 0;
            global.hp--;
            global.km--;
        }
        if(km_t &gt;= 2 + km_bonus * 2 &amp;&amp; global.km &gt;= 30) {
            km_t= 0;
            global.hp--;
            global.km--;
        }
        if(km_t &gt;= 5 + km_bonus * 3 &amp;&amp; global.km &gt;= 20) {
            km_t= 0;
            global.hp--;
            global.km--;
        }
        if(km_t &gt;= 15 + km_bonus * 5 &amp;&amp; global.km &gt;= 10) {
            km_t= 0;
            global.hp--;
            global.km--;
        }
        if(km_t &gt;= 30 + km_bonus * 10) {
            km_t= 0;
            global.hp--;
            global.km--;
        }
        if(global.hp &lt;= 0) global.hp= 1;
    }
    prevhp= global.hp;
}
